description: Perennial from a taproot. Basal rosette of runcinate, backward-lobed leaves. Solitary yellow ligulate head on a hollow, leafless, unbranched scape. No leafy flowering stem.
source: Flora of North America vol. 19 (Taraxacum); card #01
notes: A rosette of leaves alone is NOT acceptable -- the yellow head is what identifies it on a card. A seed head alone is also not acceptable for this reference style.
derived_from: botanical description and the printed card, NOT a colour signature
